title: Share of boys enrolled in pre-primary school
subtitle: Comparing [net](#dod:net-enrollment-ratio) and [gross enrollment ratios](#dod:gross-enrolment-ratio) for boys in [pre-primary](#dod:pre-primary-education) education. Net enrollment shows the share of boys of pre-primary school age (between 3 and 5 years old) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all boys regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of boys of the same age group.
